SQL:
WITH eligible AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT a.node_id,a.resolutionId,a.content,a.sequence,m.sourceReportedEndDate AS meetingPeriodEndDate
 FROM Meeting AS m
 JOIN rel_MADE_AT AS ma ON ma.dst_id=m.node_id
 JOIN Agreement AS a ON a.node_id=ma.src_id
 WHERE a.hasFFS=1
)
SELECT DISTINCT e.resolutionId AS resolutionId,e.content AS content,e.meetingPeriodEndDate AS meetingPeriodEndDate,ag.agendaNumber AS agendaNumber,e.sequence AS sequence
FROM eligible AS e
LEFT JOIN rel_RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO AS rb ON rb.src_id=e.node_id
LEFT JOIN AgendaItem AS ag ON ag.node_id=rb.dst_id
ORDER BY e.meetingPeriodEndDate DESC,(ag.agendaNumber IS NULL) ASC,ag.agendaNumber ASC,(e.sequence IS NULL) ASC,e.sequence ASC,e.resolutionId ASC;
